niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, high-hierarchy interfaces that feel intentional and composed: spacious layouts, clear sectioning, strong but controlled focal points, rounded/self-contained components, and premium editorial/app-like styling. They often like calm restrained palettes and muted surfaces, but in task-critical or operational contexts they respond well to stronger contrast, embedded screen context, and more assertive urgency signaling. They generally favor guided, paced onboarding over crowded multi-card presentations, and prefer screens that feel complete, realistic, and structurally coherent.

criteria.description: Prefers open spacing, generous whitespace, and less cramped vertical rhythm.
Prefers strong headline-to-content hierarchy, obvious focal points, and clear top-to-bottom progression.
Prefers calm, polished, contemporary, softly premium presentation over generic utilitarian styling.
Prefers content that is clearly grouped into distinct sections or self-contained areas with readable structure.
Prefers interfaces that feel embedded in a believable full product screen, with visible surrounding context and realistic states.
Prefers softly rounded cards, pill-shaped buttons, and gentler contours that make components feel tactile and refined.
Prefers stepwise, paced presentation with one primary concept at a time rather than many equal-weight items shown simultaneously.
Prefers a clearly dominant primary action with strong prominence and reduced competition from secondary controls.
Prefers fewer competing decorative elements, less clutter, and cleaner compositions with controlled accent usage.
